name: Hunger for Chaos
source:
You’re no stranger to tragedy. After your mother dies in the same car accident that scars you emotionally and physically, your father is later diagnosed with cancer that requires expensive surgery. Desperate to save your only parent, you drop out of high school and works numerous jobs to afford the lifesaving procedure. You scrape up a third of the money after four years, but by the time you gets the rest, your father will be long gone and buried. Crazy Torry Sanchez, an old high school acquaintance informs you of a dark website post, recruiting individuals who have suffered trauma for a case study in exchange for $20,000.

[From [url=https://superwritererotica.com/visualnovels/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你对悲剧并不陌生。当你的母亲在一场给你的情感和身体带来创伤的车祸中去世后，你的父亲后来被诊断出患有癌症，需要昂贵的手术。为了拯救你唯一的父母，你从高中辍学，并打了很多工作来支付救生费用。四年后，你筹集了三分之一的钱，但当你拿到剩下的钱时，你的父亲早已去世并被埋葬了。疯狂的托里·桑切斯 (Crazy Torry Sanchez) 是一位高中老友，他告诉你一个黑暗的网站帖子，招募遭受创伤的人进行案例研究，以换取20,000美元。
